text:
James (Sales): Quick one 023-03: Acme asked if we can give a short-term hosted API price break for a technical POC. They want $0.00095/token for 2 months, plus a $6k minimum per month. They need invoice billing net-30. Can we do a limited override?

Ravi (Deal Desk): Need to check precedent. Whats expected token shape (spike vs smooth)? Who signs and legal entity? Also, will they expect the lower rate to apply to all models or just the checked model?

James (Sales): Token profile: big spike first 3 weeks (~12M), then tails off. Contract signer: Maya Chen, Head of AI, Acme Dynamics, US entity. They want the discount for the gpt-open-1 family only.

Priya (Solutions): Engineering note: allowed but will need a capacity reservation for the spike window or we risk throttling. We can offer a temporary capacity reservation charge instead of a blanket unlimited override. Suggest: include a spike cap of 15M tokens in month 1; anything above billed at standard. Also can enable prefix caching to cut effective token use.

Marco (Security): POC constraints: they request DPA + basic SOC summary. Hosted POC ok with our standard retention (30d). They asked about encryption-in-transit and at-rest; standard platform guarantees both. If they want SIEM integration, thats out-of-scope for POC.

Alicia (Finance): Pricing math: Example month1 12M @0.00095 = $11,400; normal price would be $18,000. 2-month floor $6k/mo = $12k total floor. Margin at 0.00095 depends on model mix but roughly 33-40%. We need to flag this as a promotional price and ensure Revenue recognizes over service period. Also need RevOps to tag as limited override.

Ravi (Deal Desk): Draft terms Im thinking: one-time rate override "ACME-POC-2M" limited to account id (Acme Dynamics) and model tag gpt-open-1. Validity 60 days from activation then auto-reverts. Min monthly = $6k; spike protection: cap 15M month1. Invoice net-30. If everyone OK Ill create the quote and attach special-approval.

quote-bot: Quote ACME-1763618000 created: https://redwood.example/quotes/ACME-1763618000 (contains temporary rate card entry and spike cap). :page_facing_up:

James (Sales): Ill send the security questionnaire and the stub quote to Maya. She wants a clause clarifying that any extension will be repriced.

Priya (Solutions): Ops needs the spike cap and an SDK key allowlist. Also, we should add an operation window for the auto-reserve: 
```
reserve-window: 72h before first spike
api-key-whitelist: [acme-poc-key]
```

Marco (Security): OK but request: add a note that logs kept 30 days and not shared externally. If Acme requests longer retention well add an addendum.

Alicia (Finance): Approving on finance side pending RevOps tag and sign-off that this is a time-limited override. Also confirm GAAR (gross adjusted margin) noted in quote.

Ravi (Deal Desk): I'll attach the margin calc and include this as a one-off promotional override. We'll require Sales to run standard review before offering similar discounts elsewhere.

James (Sales): Sounds good. Ill confirm invoice terms and push the signed quote when returned. Thanks all. :pray:

Ravi (Deal Desk): Logging internal note: any hosted-API token unit override < $0.001 requires Deal Desk + Finance approval and must include a min monthly commit of at least $5k.

Priya (Solutions): Ops note added to ticket.

Marco (Security): Ping me if the questionnaire shows any special data handling.

James (Sales): Closing loop here and moving to Legal.
